set: SS11 Design editor pictures (photographs a designer places in a frame)
alt: (empty: decorative, the canvas names the layer)
prompt:
Image 1 is a style reference only: copy its medium, palette, light, colour grading and level of detail. Do not copy its subject or composition.
Use: a photograph a designer has placed as an image fill in a 320×200 hero frame of a mobile web page in a design tool, seen at up to 2× zoom, cropped to fill the frame.
Subject: a coastal wildflower meadow above the sea.
Details: poppies, ox-eye daisies and grasses on a cliff-top meadow, the sea calm and blue beyond, a few soft clouds, bright midday daylight, a clear blue sky; not sunset, not dusk, no orange sky.
Composition: 16:10 landscape, the subject in the centre third so a crop keeps it, eye level, uncluttered.
Style: natural editorial photograph by the sea, real lens and depth, soft natural colour grading, calm, no people's faces.
Constraints: no text, no letters or numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame or border, no recognisable landmarks.
